title: DFT defect calculation
action: Perform hybrid functional DFT calculations (HSE06, 160-atom supercell) for bulk β-Ga2O3 and for 2V-Ga1–Ga_i defect complexes at ic and ib interstitial sites. Compute total energies for relevant charge states and obtain relaxed defect structures.
description: Heavy DFT calculation step. The resulting relaxed structures and total energies are used to compute formation energies and transition levels.

title: Formation energies
action: From the DFT total energies and chemical potentials, compute the formation energies of 2V_Ga1–Ga_i (ic and ib) complexes as a function of Fermi level and write formation_energies.json.
description: JSON with formation energies per charge state and site, including chemical potentials (μ_O, μ_Ga). Must enable verification of ordering i_c < i_b < i_a.
output_schema: JSON object: {'system': string, 'charge_states': [int], 'formation_energies': {'<site>_<charge>': {'mu_O': float, 'mu_Ga': float, 'energy_eV': float}, ...}, 'data_source': string}

title: Charge-state transition levels
action: For each defect complex (ic and ib), determine the thermodynamic charge-state transition level (e.g., ε(-/-2) or ε(-2/-3)) in eV above VBM and write transition_levels.json as a JSON array of objects.
description: JSON array of transition levels for ic and ib complexes. The deep acceptor level must be consistent with paper-reported range within tolerance.
output_schema: JSON array of objects: [{'defect': string, 'transition': string, 'level_eV': float, 'method': string}, ...]

title: Multislice HAADF-STEM intensity profiles
action: Run multislice simulation code (Dr. Probe or equivalent) using the relaxed defect structures from the DFT step. Simulate HAADF-STEM images for a 25 nm thick crystal along [010] projection with microscope parameters C_s3=0.002 mm, C_s5=1.0 mm, convergence half-angle 20.0 mrad, 300 kV. Produce line profiles of HAADF intensity across Ga1 columns adjacent to interstitials for defect-free and defect-containing configurations, and write simulated_intensity_profiles.csv.
description: CSV with columns: distance_nm, intensity_defect_free, intensity_with_defect. The profile must clearly show decreased Ga1 column intensity adjacent to interstitials.
output_schema: CSV columns: distance_nm (float), intensity_defect_free (float), intensity_with_defect (float). Header required.
